Bilingual setup/support guidance and a fresh isolated Windows package are ready for independent verification; security/auth review remains blocked.

Credential-storage documentation now reflects Windows DPAPI and environment-only non-Windows behavior; packaged bilingual browser checks passed. Independent review is next; security remains blocked.

Independent review and release checks remain blocked; provider environment-key non-persistence wording conflicts with the Windows settings-save path, and the release audit has stale localization verification statements.

Both requested worktree fixes and focused provider tests verified; product change remains uncommitted because its required provider settings module is pre-existing untracked work, and security/release checks remain blocked or unverified.
